ValidationRule.description: Prevents users on the Charity Events Standard User profile from editing Event Registration records that are not of Volunteer ticket type. This enforces the Volunteer Coordinator persona restriction: Volunteer Coordinators may only edit Volunteer-type registrations. Note: this rule uses the base profile name as a proxy for the Volunteer Coordinator persona. If a dedicated profile is introduced in future, or for a more robust long-term solution, consider replacing the profile check with a Custom Permission.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Volunteer Coordinators may only edit Volunteer ticket registrations.
